yojana_opportunities.title: Yojana Opportunity Finder
features: Domain filters (Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy)

antigravity_effect.behavior: Gentle cursor reactivity with floating golden-emerald nodes; automatically stops if prefers-reduced-motion is active

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive buttons, role tabs, opportunity cards, form inputs, modal triggers, and navigation links MUST carry data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='role-switcher-student', data-testid='apply-opportunity-btn-1').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_ratio: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large headers
testing_and_accessibility.reduced_motion: Wrap particle / float effects in media query check or motion.div with reduced motion fallback

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a clean, highly functional JS/React web frontend prototype with full mock data.
Prominently embed the official Ministry of Ayush logo alongside 'SAMANVAYA' title in the primary header.
Implement the Demo Persona Switcher at the top to seamlessly swap dashboard views between Student, Employer, Alumni, Institution, and Ministry.
Ensure all major flows (Pariksha, Yojana, Karma, Pramana) have rich mock datasets, interactive states, modals, and filters.
Include subtle cursor-reactive antigravity particle effect on the hero background with reduced motion compliance.
Use data-testid on every interactive element.
